profile.headline: Eric Schorling - Experienced Front-End Developer Specializing in React & TypeScript | Building Robust Applications with Electron & Node.js | Advanced Expertise in Docker, PostgreSQL & GraphQL
profile.summary: Eric Schorling is a full stack software engineer with demonstrated leadership and an unending passion for learning to code. He recently completed a full stack web development boot camp where he learned to code full stack single page applications using PostgreSQL, Express, Node, and React.  He also has experience coding in Python and building websites using CSS and HTML. He has experience deploying websites to AWS as well as building state-managed applications using Redux. He has created several web applications that have been deployed and are available at quiz-yoself.com and hashedpantry.com. He lives in Charlottesville and is looking for a local or remote position as a full stack web developer. Eric Schorling has a proven track record of increasing his coding skills not only by participating in the full stack web development boot camp but also enrolling in a Masters of Computer Science degree. Before moving into web development, Eric Schorling was a leader in Supply Chain and Operations building and managing teams using lean methodologies. Most recently he managed a team of developers as they created and deployed a new company website. Eric Schorling is an avid runner and has completed three marathons including one with his wife.

positions.title: Director of Operations and Technology
positions.description:
Technology
- Oversee a six-person development team to create and manage web assets for internal and external customers
- Work with a three-person team to develop a new customer-facing website using Scrum and Agile techniques
- Leverage Bootstrap and Javascript to build front-end UI applications for e-commerce solution. 
- Work directly with developers to build out a full production suite to support heat transfer operations.
- Direct IT and Business Systems teams to secure data and support internal ERPs

Operations
- Oversee full supply chain of heat transfer business unit including research and development, sourcing, manufacturing, quality assurance, and fulfillment.
- Manage 12 person supervisor team with 200 indirect reports to manufacture and distribute heat transfers to businesses throughout the world
- Create process improvement plans that reduced waste and increased the performance of operators
- Manage recruiting of hourly and salaried positions including creating and deploying hiring tactics to create a successful team member pipeline

positions.title: Senior Operations Manager
positions.description:
Inbound 2018 - 2020
• Led a team of 8 direct and 230 indirect reports in inbound operations for a 50M carton site.
• Reduced safety incidents by 40% and injuries by 30% through team member accountability programs and increased safety audits at all levels
• Reduced inbound pallet defects by 50% through team member communication and training programs, Operations manager training, and increased visual management in the work place.
• Improved inbound cycle by 55% through improved operations manager routines, reduction in waste during receipt, and improved productivity.
• Improved productivity by 25% by developing a team of operations managers who actively found and reduced waste throughout the department.
Breakpack - 2017 -2019
 Led a team of 6 direct and 215 indirect reports in both the picking and packing departments.
• Improved packing performance by 25% through standard work improvements, visual management, and improved productivity tracking.
• Increased picking cartons per hour by 40% through waste reduction in travel time.
• Reduced injuries in the department by 22% through development of safety team, utilization of Gemba routines to identify root causes, and improved visual management in packing work area.

positions.title: Quality Manager
positions.description:
• Managed store order defects for 50M carton site
• Improved defect rate to top 3 in the company through daily waste identification routines, team member training, and visual management.
• Created multiple programs to identify defect creations and create effective counter measures to remove defects from process.

positions.title: Distribution Operations Manager
positions.description:
• Lead a team of 30+ direct reports in stocking, picking, and
transportation in a 1.5M sq ft building
• Improved department to best in class in the company through cross key partnerships and team development.
• Reduced quality DPMO by 20% through improved quality routines and team member follow up.

positions.title: Senior Supply Chain Manager
positions.description:
Management of Operations Department and supply chain including Purchasing, Inventory Control, Quality Control, Warehousing, Manufacturing, and Shipping Departments consisting of 6 direct and 30 indirect reports. Report directly to the President and Vice President. Oversee the manufacture and distribution of millions units annually. Create shipping and manufacturing schedule for millions in sales. Create operations and supply chain procedures for new products. 

•	Reduced production lead times by 75% through the use of flexible staffing, improved employee engagement, and better production tracking.

•	Improved scheduling and inventory control by creating the company’s first inventory and scheduling systems. 

•	Oversaw a 100% increase in production demand through the addition of new production lines. 

•	Enhanced product quality by reducing machine errors and creating new quality control procedures. 

•	Reduced chargebacks through new pack out processes that increase the depth of quality control in the distribution process.

positions.title: Purchasing Agent
positions.description:
Responsible for a million dollar purchasing budget for 100s of items including COGs, corrugated, and POPs. Create and communicate purchase orders and releases to vendors. Source new products and develop new vendors for existing products. Schedule deliveries. Manage inventory systems and oversee inventory control.

•	Reduced fixed costs 2% in 2014 by developing new vendors with improved capabilities. 

•	Reduced variable costs by 3% through vendor negotiations and waste reduction. 

•	Improve product quality by enhancing vendor-side quality control procedures and enhancing vendor relationships.

•	Reduced stock-outs and increased shipping turn around times by developing new Inventory systems.
